importantFindings: Bayliner 3270 Explorer / 3270 Motor Yacht / 3288 is one continuing hull/model lineage with sequential marketing names.
Bayliner 3788 contains two materially different generations (1996–99 and 2001–02); dimensions are now production-phase scoped instead of falsely model-wide.
The 2001–02 Bayliner 3788 directly became the Meridian 381 Sedan in 2003.
Carver naming frequently changed without a new hull: 3297→330 Mariner, 33→350 Aft Cabin, 350→36 Mariner, and 3807→390 Aft Cabin.
Carver 355/356 reference contains an apparent 30-foot length typo; B-Atlas records the conflict and does not promote it.
Silverton 372 became 392 for 1999–2001 and is handled as one continuing model with naming phases.
The legacy Meridian 341 record was structurally wrong: the 2003–04 and 2005–14 341s are completely different boats. They are now two canonical records.
Meridian 2003–04 341 derives from Bayliner 3488 Command Bridge lineage; Meridian 381 derives from revised Bayliner 3788 lineage.
